run_linear_evaluation: run a linear classifier evaluation on ImageNet using a pretrained ResNet50 model checkpoint
run_finetune_evaluation: run a finetune evaluation on ImageNet using a pretrained ResNet50 model with cosine annealing
run_few_shot_evaluation: run a linear evaluation on ImageNet using only 1 or 10 percent of the training set
review_AverageMeter: review the python AverageMeter class that computes and stores average and current values for metrics
test_accuracy: test the python accuracy function that computes top-k accuracy over predictions for specified k values
